cohort: The study included women with twin pregnancies who gave birth in Korea between 2007 and 2016, identified from the national birth registry.
finding: Over a 10-year period (2007-2016) in Korea, the rate of twin pregnancies increased, as did the risks of preterm birth, cesarean section, gestational diabetes mellitus, and postpartum hemorrhage, while the risk of twin growth discordance decreased.
mod_finding: The risk of cesarean section increased significantly from 2007 to 2016 (aOR, 1.16; 95% CI, 1.03-1.29).
